method: scripts/measure_human_fp.py - production AIDetectionOrchestrator (safe-blend) over known-human corpora; post-recalibration rerun (see docs/HUMAN_FP_BASELINE.md)

kaggle_student_code.description: Real novice student Python submissions (Kaggle corpus)

caveats: Kaggle corpus is human by dataset construction, not per-file ground truth
Single corpus, Python-only; IR-Plag originals are Java and few (n=7)
Binoculars layer absent (falls back to heuristics, same as default deployment)
Post-recalibration figures (2026-09-21) documented in docs/HUMAN_FP_BASELINE.md; control corpora unaffected (0% FP at every band)

band_caveats.high: On real student code, ~2% of human submissions score in this band (>= 0.70)
band_caveats.medium: On real student code, ~10% of human submissions score in this band (>= 0.40)
